current_hypotheses.subject: cursor-is-byte-offset
current_hypotheses.statement: A resume cursor is a byte offset, not a line count, so a partial trailing line can be re-read.

current_hypotheses.subject: rotation-restarts-read
current_hypotheses.statement: A rotated or truncated log must rewind the cursor and report a restart cause.
